feats.title: Arbiter of Justice
feats.description: You deal +2 damage against bloodied targets. Additionally, whenever an ally bloodies or reduces your oath of enmity target to 0 hit points, you may act as though you had bloodied or reduced the target to 0 hit points.

feats.title: Avenging Surge
feats.description: When an ally hits your oath of enmity target, you gain temporary hit points equal to 3 + 3 per ally adjacent to that target.

feats.title: Censure's Grip
feats.description: When you have combat advantage against your oath of enmity target and hit it with an avenger power, your target cannot shift away from you until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Devout Guidance
feats.description: When you use your divine guidance, the target gains a +3 power bonus to the second attack roll.

feats.title: Eager for Blood
feats.description: During the first round of combat, your avenger weapon attacks deal 1[W] extra damage.

feats.title: Exposing Oath
feats.description: While a creature is your oath of enmity target, your attacks ignore any resist radiant or resist necrotic the target has.

feats.title: Halo of Isolation
feats.description: While adjacent to your oath of enmity target, all other enemies treat squares adjacent to you as difficult terrain.

feats.title: Inexorable Pursuit
feats.description: When you charge your oath of enmity target, you can ignore difficult terrain and move through enemies' spaces during the charge.

feats.title: Inspiring Oath
feats.description: When you use oath of enmity, one ally you can see can shift 2 squares closer to your target as a free action.

feats.title: Onslaught of Enmity
feats.description: When you use oath of enmity, you can shift 2 squares closer to the target as a free action.

feats.title: Painful Oath
feats.description: The first time you hit your oath of enmity target each turn, you deal extra radiant and necrotic damage equal to your Wisdom.

feats.title: Pledge of Retribution
feats.description: If you miss your oath of enmity target with an attack, you gain a +1 bonus to the next attack roll you make against that target before the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Protected Isolation
feats.description: While you are adjacent to your oath of enmity target, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
